madagascar.title: Flag of the Republic of Madagascar

colors.note: Represents purity; paired with red it recalls the Merina kingdom's colours.
Symbolises sovereignty and the Merina monarchy of pre-colonial Madagascar.
Represents the Hova, the peasant class, and hope for a prosperous nation.

desc:
- A vertical white band on the hoist side with two horizontal bands of red above green on the fly
- The unusual hoist-side vertical stripe distinguishes Madagascar from other tricolours
- Adopted on 14 October 1958 ahead of full independence from France on 26 June 1960
trivia:
- White and red were the traditional colours of the Merina kingdom that unified much of the island
- The flag was adopted two years before full independence from France
- Madagascar's flag has remained unchanged since 1958, surviving multiple republics
- The hoist-side vertical stripe is shared with few other national flags
